generate_comparison_figure: generate a multi-panel comparison PNG figure from baseline and target torch tensors
build_panels: build a list of visualization panels for baseline, target, and diff heatmap displays
create_panel_context: create a frozen dataclass context holding baseline, target, diff tensors and a name string
create_panel: create a frozen dataclass panel with a label, diff requirement flag, and draw callback
preprocess_tensor: preprocess a torch tensor into a 2d representation for visualization panels
